# BTicino C300X Integration v3.0.0

## Unreleased

3.0.0 puts the Classe 300X and, as an experiment, the Classe 100X into one
package. Everything below is new against 2.10.0.

The betas of 3.0.0 ran on a Classe 300X with firmware 1.7.19: the agent update
from 2.10.0, the entities, the Display patch, the live view, an answered call,
the door level in the station's audio chip and a function test (picture
controls, display notice, ringer mute, text memo, display reload, agent
restart, diagnostics) were fine. Firmware 2.0.2 and 3.0.6 are checked offline
against their original files.

The Classe 100X support (firmware 1.5.8) is **experimental**: it is checked
against the original firmware files offline only and is not yet confirmed on
a Classe 100X. Testing it is tracked in
[issue #51](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/issues/51).

## What You Need to Do

- Run the agent update Repair: the native agent is rebuilt as **3.0.0**.
- **Door station sound:** "Live audio level" and "Volume of ring recordings"
  are replaced by **Door level** and **Fine adjustment** under
  **Configure > Video and audio**. The old values are not taken over; the new
  defaults (Stock, 0 dB) apply. Check the sound once and adjust it there.
- Ring recordings now have the same level as the live sound. With the old
  default of +6 dB for ring recordings they are about 6 dB quieter than in
  2.10.0. For about the old recording level, set **Door level** to +6 dB;
  this also raises the live sound (and, on a Classe 300X, calls answered in
  the BTicino app).
- The camera attribute `doorstation_audio_gain_db` is removed; templates that
  read it need a change.
- Nothing else: the card type, the service IDs, the blueprint files and every
  entity stay as they are, so existing dashboards and automations keep
  working.

## Sound and Picture

- **Clean picture from the first frame.** Live video starts with a complete
  picture in the live view, the ring preview and an answered call, instead of
  a grey or broken image until the next full frame.
- **Door level** (Stock, +3, +6, +9, +12 dB; default Stock) raises the voice
  at the source. On a Classe 300X this happens in the station's audio chip,
  before the sound is compressed, so it stays clearer than a later gain. The
  station uses the same chip setting for calls answered in the BTicino app, so
  these get louder too. On the Classe 100X the agent does it, and the app is
  not affected.
- **Fine adjustment** (-10 to +10 dB) adds to the door level.
- Both work the same with Speex and PCMU, in the live view, during a call and
  in ring recordings. Ring recordings now have the same level as the live
  sound.
- The card plays the sound as it comes and no longer adds its own gain.
- On a Classe 300X a door level above Stock replaces the station's audio
  script; Stock or removing the agent puts the original back.

## Setup

- A new Classe 300X setup offers **Home Assistant pages on the display**
  switched on where its display can take them, so the station gets the
  display pages right away. Existing
  entries keep their setting. On a Classe 100X it stays off, because its
  pages are activated separately.
- **Reinstall when the keys are lost.** When Home Assistant no longer has the
  agent's keys (for example after Home Assistant or the integration was
  installed again without a backup), the key dialog in setup and in the
  re-authentication offers **Reinstall the agent**. Home Assistant installs
  the agent again over SSH with new keys and keeps them. The display pages
  stay as they are. If the station already has an entry, that entry gets the
  new keys; no second entry is created. Once the new keys are on the station,
  Home Assistant keeps them even when a later step fails, and a retry
  finishes cleanly. A reinstall from the re-authentication or the agent
  update Repair stops before changing anything when the address leads to a
  different station.
- Adding a station again with its keys while an entry from an older release
  still points at it updates that entry instead of creating a second one.
- Manual setup says **C300X/C100X** in its texts until the station has
  answered and its model is known.

## Installation over SSH

- Setup can log in with an **SSH key** (OpenSSH or PEM, with an optional
  passphrase) instead of or next to a password. Like the password, it is used
  only for the installation and not stored. RSA and ECDSA keys work on every
  firmware; Ed25519 keys only on 3.0.6.
- A login without root rights (for example `bticino2`) gets a clear message
  instead of failing halfway.
- Own messages when SSH on the station cannot be reached and when the station
  accepts only key logins.
- When Home Assistant cannot install its SSH package but a usable one is
  already there, the installation goes on with it. When none can be loaded,
  setup says so in a message of its own instead of reporting a login error.
- Setup installs nothing on a device that is not a BTicino station.
- Stations whose SSH offers an ECDSA, Ed25519 or SHA-2 RSA host key are
  accepted.
- After the station was flashed again, an outdated firewall backup no longer
  stops the installation.
- A station without the firewall file `/etc/network/if-pre-up.d/iptables` is
  installed with firewall management switched off instead of failing. Where
  that file or a directory above it is a link, the installation stops before
  it changes anything. On the Classe 300X firmwares 1.7.19, 2.0.2 and 3.0.6
  the file is a regular file, so nothing changes there.
- While the model is still unknown, setup tries the C100X factory password
  after the station refused the C300X one, before it asks for a login.

## Names and Languages

- **Names without the model.** The card picker lists the card as **BTicino
  Doorbell Call Card** (before: C300X Doorbell Call Card). The blueprints are
  called **BTicino ...** instead of **C300X ...**, their device input is called
  **Door station**, and the services are listed without "C300X" in their names
  (for example **Run action** instead of Run C300X action). Only the displayed
  names changed.
- The device page shows the station's board as hardware version and its
  article number as model ID.
- **Spanish.** Home Assistant texts, the card, event labels, memo and video
  message names and the station display pages are available in Spanish. The
  station pages follow the station's language (Classe 300X); the Classe 100X
  shows English, because its firmware reports no language. The forwarding
  text on the station shows in Spanish too; a text written by an earlier
  release is renewed by the agent update Repair.

## Switches

- **SSH:** on a station where another tool runs its own SSH service, the
  switch shows SSH as on, names that tool and cannot be switched there.
- **Legacy MQTT bridge:** when switched off, the old bridge stays off even when
  a watchdog of the rooting tool tries to start it again; switching it on, or
  removing the agent, gives it back.

## Classe 100X (Experimental)

- Setup recognises a Classe 100X on firmware 1.5.8 and installs nothing on it
  until you confirm the experimental support in the setup dialog. A Classe
  300X is never asked.
- What the model offers:
  [Models and Features](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0/docs/reference.md#models-and-features).
- The display pages come as a separate adapter that one reboot activates,
  operated with the station's keys:
  [Classe 100X: Station Display](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0/docs/classe-100x/3-display.md).
- With active display pages, the agent update Repair renews the pages when
  the update brings newer ones: the station reboots once, after it has been
  idle for about two minutes, never during a call and only while the
  maintenance reboot is allowed. A station with the original display is not
  rebooted.
- Before the first installation, read
  [Classe 100X: Setup](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0/docs/classe-100x/1-setup.md);
  it links the private backup and the device test.

## Fixed

- After the camera's entity ID was changed, the camera refused every stream
  with "Camera is unloading" until the integration was reloaded.
- After the audio codec select's entity ID was changed, a codec change did not
  finish after the station's restart and the select stopped updating until
  the integration was reloaded.
- A Display patch write that failed and could not be rolled back, or that had
  to be stopped, left a copy of the display files in the station's memory
  until the next restart.
- After the camera was removed and added again, its automatic recovery from
  a stuck "busy" state no longer ran.
- The SSH password in the agent update Repair is now hidden while you type.

## Documentation

- The documentation is rewritten per model. The README is a short overview
  with five steps for each model (setup, use, station display,
  troubleshooting, update and removal); every page ends with a link to the
  next step. One
  [reference page](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0/docs/reference.md)
  lists the features per model, the options, entities, actions, Notify fields
  and events.
- The setup page names the third-party projects for SSH access per firmware,
  also davemajor's USB root for 3.0.6, which sets up SSH key login, and
  assumes a clean firmware with only SSH enabled
  ([Enable SSH on the Station](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0/docs/classe-300x/1-setup.md#enable-ssh-on-the-station)).

## Still Unverified on a Station

- The ring preview with the clean first frame.
- The door level in the audio chip on firmware 2.0.2 and 3.0.6.
- Everything on a Classe 100X: installation, calls, stream, picture controls,
  the display activation by reboot and its rollback.

## Upgrade

1. Install 3.0.0 from Marketplace or HACS and restart Home Assistant if it
   asks you to.
2. Run the agent update Repair; it installs the 3.0.0 agent together with its
   display files.
3. Set **Door level** and **Fine adjustment** under **Configure > Video and
   audio** if the default sound does not suit you.

Before going back to 2.10.0 or older on a Classe 300X, set **Door level** to
**Stock** (or remove the agent), then select the older release and run the
agent update Repair again. On firmware 3.0.6, before going back to a release
older than 2.10.0, also remove the display overlay with
`qml_patch.sh restore-all`. No older release supports a Classe 100X: to go
back there, remove the agent, which also restores the original display
([Classe 100X: Update and Removal](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v3.0.0/docs/classe-100x/5-update-and-removal.md)).
